overview: This paper proposes PESO, a continual adaptation method for LoRA in LLM-based recommender systems, which uses a proximal regularizer anchored to the previous adapter state to balance stability and plasticity, and evaluates it against single evolving and cumulative LoRA variants on chronological Amazon Review datasets.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Chronological Split
modules.description: Loads Amazon Review datasets, filters users by minimum interaction count, and splits the interaction data chronologically into a large pretraining block and multiple smaller incremental blocks.

modules.name: Semantic ID Tokenization
modules.description: Implements or interfaces with a codebook-based tokenizer to convert item text features into hierarchical semantic ID token sequences for generative recommendation.

modules.name: Sliding Window Dataset and DataLoader
modules.description: Constructs training instances by applying a sliding window over user interaction sequences to create multiple prefix-target pairs, and manages batched data loading for LLM fine-tuning.

modules.name: Prompt Templating
modules.description: Formats the user's interaction history and the target item into the specific textual prompt structure required by the LLM for the generative recommendation task.

modules.name: LoRA Architecture Integration
modules.description: Implements the Low-Rank Adaptation matrices and injects them into the target modules of the LLM backbone, freezing the base weights and managing the parameter subspace.

modules.name: Continual Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the sequential training pipeline across chronological stages, handling model checkpointing, LoRA state transitions between stages, and scaling of the learning rate for incremental blocks.

modules.name: Baseline: Single Evolving LoRA
modules.description: Implements the baseline where a single LoRA adapter is sequentially fine-tuned on new data blocks by initializing its parameters from the previous stage's state.

modules.name: Baseline: Cumulative LoRA Variants
modules.description: Implements the family of cumulative LoRA baselines, including SumLoRA and SD-LoRA, supporting configurations with normalized directions, fixed or learnable magnitudes, parameter inheritance, and selective adapter aggregation.

modules.name: PESO: Proximal Regularization Framework
modules.description: Implements the core PESO objective, which combines the autoregressive cross-entropy loss with a generalized quadratic proximal term that penalizes deviations of the current LoRA parameters from the previous stage's parameters based on a metric matrix.

modules.name: PESO: Softmax-KL Divergence Instantiation
modules.description: Implements the specific instantiation of the proximal regularizer using per-module softmax-KL divergence, computing the penalty based on the variance of parameter changes weighted by the prior state's softmax probabilities.

modules.name: Constrained Beam Search Inference
modules.description: Implements the autoregressive generation logic using constrained beam search that restricts the output vocabulary to valid item token IDs, generating a ranked list of predicted items.

modules.name: Recommendation Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Calculates the Hit and NDCG metrics at specified ranks for the generative recommendation task by comparing the generated item list against the ground-truth next item.

modules.name: Stability-Plasticity User Segmentation Evaluation
modules.description: Implements evaluation logic to segment users into dormant and new user groups across different time stages to separately assess the model's stability and plasticity.

modules.name: Proximal Regularizer Ablation Suite
modules.description: Implements alternative regularization strategies for comparison, including L2 proximal, orthogonality constraints, LoRA-output KL, and per-rank KL, to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed per-module softmax-KL.

modules.name: Distribution Shift Quantification
modules.description: Implements a domain discrimination method using logistic regression on sequence embeddings to compute drift scores between sequential data blocks, validating the presence of distribution shift.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations for different datasets, methods, and hyperparameter settings, and integrates logging and monitoring tools to track training loss, metrics, and resource usage.
